A_behavior_source_native.source: The helper selects the last visible terminal assistant answer, requires requested code and heading in semantic answer text, then requires the focused text Range to be in viewport and within clip bounds with a quarter-device-pixel tolerance. Driver sequence captures code focus then a distinct heading focus; simultaneous fit of the long reply is not required.
A_behavior_source_native.paint-contract: Code-focus capture proves requested latest-answer code paint; separate heading-focus capture supplies heading paint evidence.
A_behavior_source_native.evidence: Pre-fix native 360x421 frame visibly paints requested code; measured Range right=336.02 CSS px vs clip right=336 explains false rejection. Current sources include both focus captures.
A_behavior_source_native.limit: No exact-source post-6bd native run/frame with recorded DPR was found. Existing pre-fix frame cannot confirm repaired native acceptance; separate heading frame after repair likewise unverified.

B_quality.addressed: 6bd replaces fixed 0.25 CSS px with 0.25/max(1,DPR), records DPR, and tests left/right/top/bottom crop behavior plus DPR4 and the observed 0.02 excess. This addresses prior fixed-tolerance and edge-coverage concerns.
B_quality.remaining: Tests synthesize DOM Range/clip geometry rather than exercising raster paint; no native post-fix evidence validates the quarter-device-pixel assumption at the actual capture scale. Exact 6bd focused CI status was not independently established from available evidence.

scope: No edits, browser launch, or suite rerun.
